scope: Same generated C and label descriptors. Shared computed-goto dispatch in all emitted procedure hosts. Same native options and original loader. Diagnostic only.
cTransform:
host_re = re.compile(r"(^#define ___PH_PROC (\w+)\n.*?^___END_P_COD\n)",re.M|re.S)
def coalesce_dispatch(code):
    hosts = list(host_re.finditer(code))
    split = {m[2].rsplit("_cfg_",1)[0] for m in hosts if re.search(r"_cfg_[1-3]$",m[2])}
    assert hosts and "#define ___HOST_LAYOUT ___HOST_LAYOUT_PROCEDURES" in code
    targets = {m[2] for m in hosts}
    prefix = """#if defined(___USE_LABEL_VALUES) && defined(___INLINE_JUMPS)
#pragma push_macro("___JUMPFAST")
#pragma push_macro("___END_SW")
#undef ___JUMPFAST
#undef ___END_SW
#define ___JUMPFAST(dest) {___pc=dest; goto ___shared_jump;}
#define ___END_SW goto ___jumpext; ___shared_jump: if (___EXPECT_FALSE(___LABEL_HOST_GET(___pc) != ___HOST_PROC)) goto ___jumpext; goto *___LABEL_HOST_LABEL_GET(___pc); ___jumpext:
"""
    prefix += "#endif\n"
    suffix = '#if defined(___USE_LABEL_VALUES) && defined(___INLINE_JUMPS)\n#pragma pop_macro("___END_SW")\n#pragma pop_macro("___JUMPFAST")\n#endif\n'
    return host_re.sub(lambda m:prefix+m[1]+suffix if m[2] in targets else m[1],code), sorted(targets)
